To make Fran Launcher appear when you press Home:

Android TV: Settings > Device Preferences > Home screen (or Apps > Default apps > Home, depending on the TV) and pick Fran Launcher.

Google TV has no such picker. From a computer with adb and network debugging enabled:

adb connect <TV IP>:5555
adb shell cmd package set-home-activity pakvothe.franlauncher.tv/.Home

If the TV keeps going back to the original home, that launcher can be disabled (reversible):

adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 com.google.android.tvlauncher

To undo: adb shell pm enable com.google.android.tvlauncher

A system update may re-enable the original home.

Requires notification access. Nothing leaves the TV: the permission is only used to know what is playing.

This TV does not show the screen to grant it. From a computer with adb:

adb shell cmd notification allow_listener pakvothe.franlauncher.tv/pakvothe.franlauncher.tv.media.MediaAccessService

To remove it: the same command with disallow_listener.
